item.title: Sudanese paramilitary forces kill at least 28 people in an attack in Darfur, medical group says
item.description: CAIRO (AP) — An attack by Sudanese paramilitary forces on a stronghold of a Darfur tribal leader left at least 28 people dead, a doctors group said Tuesday, the latest in a devastating war with no resolution in sight.
